pages.text:
“Miss Fizz! It is a fox, a
box, a bell and a hill.”

Miss Fizz will mull. Is it a
hill? Is it a fox?
Yes, it is a fox on a hill.

Jess did well. The fox is
on a hill. The fox is fat!

Bess will mix the fox, box
and bell on the hill.

A fat fox on a hill. A mix of
a fox, a box, and a bell on a
hill.
